Pick your cup

Everything at Grub leaves the bar in one of three cups. Keep scrolling and each one turns for you. Grab it and drag if you want a closer look.

Hot

The paper cup

Hot drinks pulled to order, steamed milk and latte art on top. The green logo means it came from our bar.

Two spouts, one cupEvery hot drink starts as a fresh shot.

Iced tea & coolers

The clear cup

Shaken over ice and served in clear plastic so the colour does the talking. Pick a flavour and watch the cup change.

The one with the heart
